primary_interpretation: Explanation evidence is model-dependent. RF and XGB show the frozen TIER_2 pattern of global structure-null exceedance plus OVERALL featurewise BH-FDR evidence. LR is TIER_0 because its OVERALL global structure did not exceed the frozen Cycle24 null, although featurewise changes were present. Therefore the result is a majority-model TIER_2 pattern, not a universal binary explanation-drift or stability result.
